nodes.name: When called
nodes.notes: severity is one of info | stop | fail. A stop is the pipeline working correctly and must never render red.

nodes.name: Format
nodes.notes: Severity → colour and wording. Amber "awaiting a decision" for stop; red for fail only.

nodes.name: Slack configured?
nodes.notes: RBL_SLACK_WEBHOOK unset is a valid deployment, not an error. Both branches reach the email node.

nodes.name: Post to Slack
nodes.notes: continueRegularOutput: a Slack outage must not swallow the email. The webhook URL is an n8n variable, never a literal here.

nodes.name: Send email
nodes.notes: Swap for Send Email (SMTP) or Slack-only if Gmail is not the channel — only sendTo/subject/message need copying. Credentials live in n8n, never in this file.

nodes.name: Sent
nodes.notes: Reports which channels actually delivered. nobodyWasTold=true means the alert reached no one.

nodes.name: Has attachments?
nodes.notes: Attachments ride only on the final delivery (§3.5) — every other notification is text.

nodes.name: Load the client documents
nodes.notes: Reads the client PDFs off disk as binary. continueRegularOutput: a missing file must not swallow the delivery message.
